scholarship_title: UnicalAdmission Scholarships for International Master's Degrees 2026/2027
provider_organization: University of Calabria (Università della Calabria, UniCal)
degree_fields: Other programmes listed in the call

financial_coverage.tuition_coverage: Tuition covered: scholarship winners pay only EUR 18.75 at enrolment (non-scholarship places pay EUR 1,000)

stipend.notes: Pocket money of about EUR 3,600, paid after enrolment. Repay it if you earn fewer than 20 ECTS by 30 Nov 2027. Renewal for year 2 needs 30 ECTS by 10 Aug 2027 and a new application (July 2027).

application_fee.notes: EUR 10 to take part in the admission procedure

eligibility_criteria.min_gpa: Foreign university degree valid for Italian master's admission, meeting each programme's requirements; places are ranked on qualifications
language_proficiency: English or Italian (language of the programme), checked in an online interview

required_documents.name: Online application form with required uploads
Degree certificate and transcripts
required_documents.detail: Valid for admission to an Italian master's

required_documents.name: ISEE parificato (equivalent ISEE)
required_documents.detail: Scholarship winners, by 30 Oct 2026; based on 2024 income and assets, translated into Italian and legalised or apostilled. Students from 'particularly poor and developing countries' instead need a certificate from the Italian embassy that their family is not high income

required_documents.name: Translated, legalised degree with Declaration of Value or CIMEA certificates
required_documents.detail: After enrolment, by 28 Feb 2027 at the latest

required_documents.name: Passport
required_documents.detail: In-person identification at the Welcome Office by 30 Oct 2026

preparation_alerts: Household income must be below EUR 26,500 (independent), 41,500 (two-person family) or 54,000 (three or more) for scholarship places
Start the ISEE parificato or the Italian embassy income certificate early; it takes weeks
Get your degree translated and legalised and request a Declaration of Value or CIMEA certificate
Conditional enrolment deadline was 10 Jun 2026 (reallocated places 31 Jul 2026)

criteria.notes: At least twice the number of places are invited to the oral exam

criteria.criterion: Remote oral exam in the programme's language
criteria.notes: Checks subject knowledge, background and language

selection_criteria.pass_rule: Separate merit rankings for scholarship and non-scholarship places; ties go to the younger candidate

source_urls.title: University of Calabria: UnicalAdmission page
source_urls.used_for: Number of scholarships, coverage, allowance, next-call timing

source_urls.title: UniCal: Unicaladmission master's call 2026/27, English (PDF)
source_urls.used_for: Places, fee, income limits, selection, deadline and time, benefits, ISEE, Declaration of Value, renewal rules

verification_status.verification_notes: Updated after reading the full 2026/27 English call (Rector's decree 287/2026): deadline 30 Mar 2026 23:59 Italian time, EUR 10 fee, income thresholds, selection by CV plus remote oral exam, benefits (enrolment fee, free housing and canteen, about EUR 3,600 pocket money), ISEE parificato by 30 Oct 2026, Declaration of Value/CIMEA by 28 Feb 2027. 132 scholarship places counted in the call table (English-taught programmes have 9 each). Whether Nigeria is on the 'particularly poor countries' list (Ministerial Decree 166/2025) was not checked. Official page said the 2027/28 call will likely be published in January 2027. Earlier note: Coverage confirmed on the official page. Deadline only from secondary sources; read the call PDF to confirm deadline, fee, documents and GPA rules. Official page says the 2027/28 call will likely be published in January 2027.
